note: Illustrative seed: 15 proposed universal L1 domains; detailed L2-L4 examples are seeded for Finance and Accounting only. Validate with domain owners before acceptance.

capabilities.name: Strategy and Corporate Management
capabilities.definition: Set enterprise direction, make strategic choices and govern enterprise-wide performance.

capabilities.name: Customer and Relationship Management
capabilities.definition: Understand, acquire, serve and sustain customer and stakeholder relationships.

capabilities.name: Marketing and Brand Management
capabilities.definition: Understand markets, shape brand meaning and create demand.

capabilities.name: Sales and Commercial Management
capabilities.definition: Convert market demand into sustainable commercial commitments.

capabilities.name: Product and Service Management
capabilities.definition: Shape, develop, manage and retire products and services.

capabilities.name: Operations Management
capabilities.definition: Plan, execute, monitor and improve operational delivery.

capabilities.name: Supply Chain and Procurement
capabilities.definition: Source, acquire and coordinate external resources and supply networks.

capabilities.name: Finance and Accounting
capabilities.definition: Plan, record, control and report financial resources and obligations.

capabilities.name: Human Capital Management
capabilities.definition: Plan, acquire, develop and sustain workforce capabilities.

capabilities.name: Risk and Compliance Management
capabilities.definition: Identify, assess, treat and monitor risk and compliance obligations.

capabilities.name: Legal and Corporate Affairs
capabilities.definition: Manage legal obligations, advice, contracts and corporate affairs.

capabilities.name: Technology and Digital Management
capabilities.definition: Govern, engineer, secure and operate technology and digital services.

capabilities.name: Data and Information Management
capabilities.definition: Govern, manage, protect and use data and information assets.

capabilities.name: Enterprise Support Services
capabilities.definition: Provide shared workplace, facilities and administrative services.

capabilities.name: Innovation and Transformation
capabilities.definition: Discover opportunities, innovate and orchestrate enterprise change.

capabilities.name: Financial Planning and Analysis
capabilities.definition: Translate strategic and operational plans into budgets, forecasts and financial decision support.

capabilities.name: Accounting and Financial Control
capabilities.definition: Record financial events, maintain accounts and enforce financial control.

capabilities.name: Treasury Management
capabilities.definition: Manage liquidity, cash, funding, financial risk and treasury operations.

capabilities.name: Tax Management
capabilities.definition: Determine, report and settle tax obligations across applicable jurisdictions.

capabilities.name: Financial Reporting
capabilities.definition: Produce reliable internal and external financial statements and disclosures.

capabilities.name: Accounts Payable and Receivable
capabilities.definition: Administer supplier obligations and collect amounts due from customers and counterparties.

capabilities.name: Cash Position Management
capabilities.definition: Establish a timely and controlled view of cash balances and available liquidity across accounts and entities.

capabilities.name: Cash Flow Forecasting
capabilities.definition: Forecast expected cash inflows and outflows across defined horizons and scenarios.

capabilities.name: Liquidity Risk Monitoring
capabilities.definition: Identify, measure and monitor liquidity exposures against approved limits and risk appetite.

capabilities.name: Bank Account Administration
capabilities.definition: Govern bank account structures, mandates, signatories and account lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Intraday Cash Position Aggregation
capabilities.definition: Aggregate intraday balances and transactions from approved account and banking data sources.

capabilities.name: Scenario-Based Cash Forecasting
capabilities.definition: Evaluate cash flow projections under approved business, market and funding scenarios.
